title: Shift Coastal Technologies deep-dossier refresh

selectedGap.reason: The published Shift profile predates material current DND procurement, Canadian Coast Guard deployment, and recent uncrewed acoustic-monitoring evidence that supports a fuller, still evidence-bounded profile.

guardrailNotes: This is an additive refresh of an existing published organization. No canonical record, capability, program or citation changes until a human reviewer accepts and explicitly publishes the candidate.
The DND award and Canadian Coast Guard collaboration are public facts; they do not establish classified requirements, endorsement, or future procurement eligibility.
LinkedIn is retained solely as discovery provenance for the possible RCN Advanced Naval Capabilities Unit activity. It is not field-level evidence in this candidate.

reviewWarnings: A Shift LinkedIn post says OceanSled Ranger supported an RCN Advanced Naval Capabilities Unit evaluation, but no durable RCN or DND page corroborating that specific activity was located; it is discovery provenance only.
CanadaBuys confirms the current DND award's title, value, dates and program path, but does not disclose technical performance, operational results or a classified requirement.
candidates.reviewerRationale: Shift Coastal Technologies is already published, but the current profile understates confirmed public activity. Its own site now gives a clear end-to-end integration, deployment and sustainment model; CanadaBuys records a current DND Innovative Solutions Canada Testing Stream research-and-development contract for AS-188 OceanSled Ranger; and Canadian Coast Guard documentation describes the first autonomous surface vessel in its fleet as the result of collaboration with Shift, including design, testing and Haida Gwaii operational use. The candidate preserves existing IDs and adds only explicit, source-backed operations. A LinkedIn claim involving the RCN Advanced Naval Capabilities Unit is deliberately not promoted into a canonical fact until durable government corroboration is found.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: Shift states that it designs, builds, integrates, deploys and sustains autonomous maritime systems, combining platforms, sensing or effecting payloads, compute, communications and command interfaces with field deployment, training and lifecycle support.

CanadaBuys identifies AS-188 OceanSled Ranger as an Innovative Solutions Canada Testing Stream research-and-development contract awarded to Shift Coastal Technologies by DND on April 20, 2026, valued at C$1,839,770.68 and scheduled to end February 26, 2027.

The Canadian Coast Guard says its first autonomous surface vessel resulted from collaboration with Shift, whose personnel worked with Coast Guard staff on design and on-water testing; the vessel supports Haida Gwaii marine emergency response, environmental protection and search-and-rescue activity.

Independent reporting describes Shift's 2026 PEMS field trial integrating an uncrewed surface vessel, towed acoustic array and controlled-deployment winch for uncrewed acoustic monitoring in demanding coastal environments.

The CanadaBuys record establishes an active, time-bounded 2026 DND research-and-development contract for AS-188 OceanSled Ranger; the Coast Guard page separately establishes prior operational collaboration and use.
